subject: Coord: Demo workshop — calendar shift & pre-flight checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Demo workshop: calendar + environment prep

Hi Laura,

Thanks for agreeing to a hands-on demo workshop for Novatech's routing and prompt flows. To make the session productive, can you confirm availability for either:

- Thursday 2026-06-23 09:00-10:30 PT
- Thursday 2026-06-23 13:00-14:30 PT

Agenda (high level):
- 15m: intro + objectives
- 30m: prompt review and routing rules
- 30m: live load tests (throughput and latency checks)
- 15m: environment checklist and next steps

Pre-flight items we need from you:
- VPC allowlist (IPs) or SSO constraints
- Name/email of infra lead to include for load testing
- Confirmation if you need a temporary sandbox API key

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf, sample-prompt-sets.md

I'll hold the 09:00 PT slot tentatively. Marcus and Monica will own the staging setup and keys.

Best,

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (11KB), sample-prompt-sets.md (4KB)

We're happy with the agenda; we do want an extra 30 minutes for load tests (so total 2 hours). Two quick asks before the session:

I'll confirm Samir's calendar once he replies — looping him in now.

Best,
Laura

Quick answers to your asks: 
- Monica will provision a scoped sandbox API key and share the credential stub before the session.
- The VPC allowlist template is attached (vpc-allowlist-template.txt). For the short-term staging tests we'll ask you to whitelist these IPs: 18.205.33.60, 35.231.12.9, 34.68.123.45.

Thanks — see you on the 24th,
